parameters.query:
MERGE INTO REVRYZE.RAW.META_ADS_DAILY t
USING (
  SELECT
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('{{$json.pulled_at}}')   AS PULLED_AT,
    TO_DATE('{{$json.date_start}}')                AS DATE_START,
    TO_DATE('{{$json.date_stop}}')                 AS DATE_STOP,
    '{{$json.ad_account_id}}'                      AS AD_ACCOUNT_ID,
    '{{$json.currency}}'                           AS CURRENCY,
    '{{$json.level}}'                              AS LEVEL,
    '{{$json.campaign_id}}'                        AS CAMPAIGN_ID,
    '{{$json.campaign_name}}'                      AS CAMPAIGN_NAME,
    '{{$json.adset_id}}'                           AS ADSET_ID,
    '{{$json.adset_name}}'                         AS ADSET_NAME,
    '{{$json.ad_id}}'                              AS AD_ID,
    '{{$json.ad_name}}'                            AS AD_NAME,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER('{{$json.impressions}}', 18, 0)  AS IMPRESSIONS,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER('{{$json.clicks}}', 18, 0)       AS CLICKS,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER('{{$json.spend}}', 18, 2)        AS SPEND,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER('{{$json.leads}}', 18, 0)        AS LEADS,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER('{{$json.purchases}}', 18, 0)    AS PURCHASES,
    TRY_PARSE_JSON('{{$json.raw_json}}')           AS RAW_JSON
) s
ON  t.DATE_START     = s.DATE_START
AND t.AD_ACCOUNT_ID  = s.AD_ACCOUNT_ID
AND t.AD_ID          = s.AD_ID

WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  PULLED_AT     = s.PULLED_AT,
  DATE_STOP     = s.DATE_STOP,
  CURRENCY      = s.CURRENCY,
  LEVEL         = s.LEVEL,
  CAMPAIGN_ID   = s.CAMPAIGN_ID,
  CAMPAIGN_NAME = s.CAMPAIGN_NAME,
  ADSET_ID      = s.ADSET_ID,
  ADSET_NAME    = s.ADSET_NAME,
  AD_NAME       = s.AD_NAME,
  IMPRESSIONS   = s.IMPRESSIONS,
  CLICKS        = s.CLICKS,
  SPEND         = s.SPEND,
  LEADS         = s.LEADS,
  PURCHASES     = s.PURCHASES,
  RAW_JSON      = s.RAW_JSON

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
  PULLED_AT, DATE_START, DATE_STOP, AD_ACCOUNT_ID, CURRENCY, LEVEL,
  CAMPAIGN_ID, CAMPAIGN_NAME, ADSET_ID, ADSET_NAME, AD_ID, AD_NAME,
  IMPRESSIONS, CLICKS, SPEND, LEADS, PURCHASES, RAW_JSON
)
VALUES (
  s.PULLED_AT, s.DATE_START, s.DATE_STOP, s.AD_ACCOUNT_ID, s.CURRENCY, s.LEVEL,
  s.CAMPAIGN_ID, s.CAMPAIGN_NAME, s.ADSET_ID, s.ADSET_NAME, s.AD_ID, s.AD_NAME,
  s.IMPRESSIONS, s.CLICKS, s.SPEND, s.LEADS, s.PURCHASES, s.RAW_JSON
);
